"""Parcel-level expert-input contract (Issue #96).

A generic, auditable overlay path for one registered, identity-safe fact of
one canonical parcel -- keyed by farm, year, stable `parcel_id` and
registered field. Deliberately a separate contract from
`api.supplemental_inputs` (the farm/year-scoped scalar `FarmReviewInput`
contract): a parcel fact varies per-parcel, never per farm/year alone, and
this module never mutates `FarmProfileSnapshot.payload` or the scalar
registry's own uniqueness/identity model.

Frozen registry (`reference/parcel_field_registry_v1.csv`): `slope_percent`,
`land_use`, `is_nonproductive_area`, `is_agroforestry_strip` (Issue #96),
`area_ha` and `operations.psm_used` (Issue #114), plus `is_biodiversity_area`
(Issue #123) -- every per-parcel wildcard fact every currently trace-capable
measure actually reads directly off a `land.parcels[]` item inside an OPA
`if` guard or `c_measure_result` pair, **plus** `is_biodiversity_area`, whose
recordability is deliberately independent of that condition (see below; see
`backend/policy/oepul_measures.rego`). `variable_path` may be dotted (e.g.
`"operations.psm_used"`) since it is genuinely nested; still never a
wildcard/array-index expression.

- `payload.land.parcels[].is_biodiversity_area` (DecisionTrace fact_id
  `parcel_biodiversity_land_use_split`): registered as an editable parcel
  fact (Issue #123 "evidence recordability is independent of current Rego
  consumption") even though no checked-in condition actually reads it inside
  an OPA `if` guard today -- `o6_1a`/`o6_1b`'s
  `land_use_specific_biodiversity_split_not_available` branch fires whenever
  `grassland_area_ha > 0` and never correlates back to any single parcel's
  `is_biodiversity_area` value (confirmed by reading `oepul_measures.rego`
  directly; the adapter still marks that condition
  `is_technical_limitation=True`). Recording a value here is therefore always
  applied to the effective payload (Canvas E: applies uniformly wherever the
  parcel scope appears) but never changes any measure's OPA outcome today:
  `api.evidence_consumption`'s versioned, fail-closed measure-consumption
  contract declares zero measures as consuming it. The evidence remains in
  the audit/management record and is reported `"not_consumed_by_measure"`,
  but is deliberately not projected into any measure payload sent to OPA --
  never a silent claim that it moved `o6_1a`/`o6_1b`. Deliberately excluded,
  and why:

- `payload.land.parcels[]` (bare wildcard, DecisionTrace fact_id
  `parcels_present`): a collection-presence signal ("no parcels of this
  category exist at all"), not a fact of one identified parcel -- no single
  parcel overlay can resolve it. System-owned (Issue #114
  `review.adapters.oepul.evidence_registry`).

def load_collection_field_registry() -> dict[str, CollectionFieldDefinition]:
    return dict(_COLLECTION_FIELD_REGISTRY)


def get_collection_field_definition(collection_path: str) -> CollectionFieldDefinition:
    definition = _COLLECTION_FIELD_REGISTRY.get(collection_path)
    if definition is None:
        raise CollectionInputError(f"Unregistered collection_path: {collection_path}")
    return definition
